HG-F1.criterion: paired bootstrap 95 percent CI low for non-Gaussian minus Gaussian SIGReg penalty is strictly positive

HG-F3.criterion: covariance, minimum eigenvalue, and projected-variance guards must all pass

HG-F4.criterion: statistic path must not read labels, z, z_pair, or source-family keys

HG-F5.criterion: failed CI separation demotes the sidecar verdict to negative/compression

negative_compression_fallback.rule: CI separation failure records negative/compression and never promotes the sidecar

not_claimed: SIGReg statistic reproduction is not a complete LeJEPA claim

no claim outside the listed source families, seeds, directions, and frequency grid
